title: Legal Secretary
description:
Private Client Legal Secretary
- Location: Farnham
- Salary: £27,000 - £30,000 (DOE)
- Job Type: Full-time, Office based

We are seeking an experienced Legal Secretary to enhance our Private Client team in Farnham. This role involves providing comprehensive secretarial support, ensuring efficient handling of a diverse caseload, and contributing to the overall client service excellence.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Provide secretarial support to the Private Client team, managing a variety of legal matters efficiently.
- Prepare legal documents, manage correspondence, and maintain files to ensure they are up-to-date.
- Utilize modern IT systems for audio and copy typing, and manage electronic diaries effectively.
- Assist in the administration of estates, drafting of wills, and preparation of other legal documents under attorney supervision.
- Ensure confidentiality and security of all practice and client documentation and information.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Proven experience as a Legal Secretary, preferably within the Private Client sector. Candidates from other legal backgrounds who demonstrate transferable skills are also encouraged to apply.
- Excellent client care skills, with a commitment to providing high-quality service.
- Strong organizational abilities and attention to detail.
- Proficiency in modern IT systems and software, including Tikit (PW4 or Partner for Windows).
- Effective communication and teamwork skills, capable of working collaboratively in a busy environment.

Benefits:
- Competitive salary with a comprehensive benefits package.
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays, with office closure between Christmas and New Year.
- Hybrid working options, subject to role requirements.
- Employer-matched pension scheme and life assurance.
- Private medical insurance and BUPA cashback plan.
- Funded professional subscriptions and support towards professional qualifications.
- Employee referral and volunteering programs.
- Social events including summer and Christmas parties.

To apply for the Private Client Legal Secretary position, please submit your CV and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and interest in this role to Mark Watts, at Reed - your local Legal Recruitment specialist.

title: Private Client Legal Secretary - Farnham, Surrey
description:
Private Client Legal Secretary - Farnham, Surrey
Full Time Permanent Competitive Salary + Benefits

Are you an experienced Private Client Legal Secretary looking for your next opportunity with a busy and growing law firm in Farnham, Surrey?

A well-established and highly regarded law firm is looking to recruit a Legal Secretary to join its successful Private Client team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced legal support professional who enjoys providing high-quality secretarial and administrative support while delivering an excellent service to clients.

The Role

Working as part of a busy Private Client department, you will provide comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to fee earners across a varied caseload.
Your responsibilities will include:
- Audio and copy typing, including correspondence and legal documents
- Diary and appointment management
- Preparing, formatting and amending documents
- Managing correspondence, emails and telephone enquiries
- Liaising professionally with clients and other third parties
- Maintaining accurate electronic and paper files
- Supporting fee earners with the day-to-day administration of Private Client matters
- Using the firm's case management and IT systems
- Helping to ensure clients receive a professional and responsive service

About You

Previous experience as a Legal Secretary within Private Client, Wills, Probate, Trusts or Estate Administration would be particularly advantageous.
However, applications are also welcomed from experienced Legal Secretaries or Legal Administrators who have worked within other areas of law and are interested in moving into Private Client.

You should have:
- Previous legal secretarial or legal administration experience
- Strong audio and copy typing skills
- Excellent organisation and diary management skills
- Confident IT and document production skills
- Strong communication and client care skills
- Excellent attention to detail
- The ability to manage competing priorities within a busy legal environment
- A positive, collaborative and team-focused approach

Previous experience using Tikit, PW4 or Partner for Windows would be beneficial but is not essential.

Why Apply?

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a busy and growing Private Client team within an established law firm offering a competitive salary and benefits package, together with opportunities for ongoing career development and progression.

If you are an experienced Legal Secretary, Private Client Secretary or Legal Administrator looking for your next opportunity in Farnham, I would be delighted to hear from you.

Please apply or get in touch confidentially to find out more.
